www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, AND THOMPSON
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
5. CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2014-011, A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE RATIFYING AND APPROVING ALL SUCCESSOR AGENCY WARRANTS ISSUED AND VOIDED ON BEHALF OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE SINCE THE LAST SUCCESSOR AGENCY WARRANT REGISTER DATED MARCH 27, 2014 AND PAYROLL REGISTER DATED MARCH 27, 2014 AND APPROVED BY THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY ON MAY 7, 2014. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
SA 5.1
5.2 Accept the monthly report on the investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale's books as of April 30, 2014. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
SA 5.2
6. JOINT PUBLIC HEARING OF THE CITY COUNCIL (ITEM NO. 8.1), SUCCESSOR AGENCY (ITEM NO. 6.1), HOUSING AUTHORITY (ITEM 6.1), INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1), PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1 ), PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1), PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1). (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
6.1 ADOPT JOINT RESOLUTION NOS. CC 2014-076, SA 2014-010, PCA 2014-001, HA 2014-004, IDA 2014-001, PAA 2014-001, AND PFA 2014-001, A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE , THE INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, AND THE PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE CITY OF PALMDALE'S BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2014-15 AND APPROVING REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE ADJUSTMENTS TO FISCAL YEAR 2013-14.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Joint Resolution Nos. CC 2014-076, SA 2014-010, PCA 2014-001, HA 2014-004, IDA 2014-001, PAA 2014-001, and PFA 2014-001. (Voice Vote - requires a majority to adopt.)
SA 6.1
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. SUCCESSOR AGENCY CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
9. PRESENTATION BY GENERAL COUNSEL of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
9.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Agency's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Successor Agency regarding possible litigation which the Agency may enter as an amicus curiae ("friend of the court"):
Successor Agency to the Former West Covina Community Development Commission, et al., v. Ana J. Matosantos
Sacramento Superior Court Case No. 34-2013-80001479
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.9 & 54956.9(c).
10. SUCCESSOR AGENCY CLOSED SESSION.

12. ADJOURNMENT:
